summary: Under ADR-0096 ordinary verification, current-composition-local.py --published-all read every custody archive of Rendering 0.32.3 from the public NuGet flat container without credentials and ran the producer's own compare against the once-read custody archives (producer 4ec6eaf, custody sha 7dbd4329...). All 19 pass payload-exact, each published archive carries exactly one feed .signature.p7s and adds 13,089 or 13,090 bytes; the three typed packages also equal their typed signed SHA-256. The result is a dated observation of live feed content, not installed adoption. Example composition: each #4818 Done-when element (local save-replay, external receipts/reconnect without replay, transformed pointer/keyboard/IME and focus input, held release, DOM islands, command ordering/coalescing/replacement/disposal) maps to executing typed cases among the 27; the report cites the assertions and their limits (IME evidence is synthetic composition events; the external case shows blur/visibilitychange only leave the authority revision unchanged; the DOM-island notes are not re-read across scene replacement). Named gaps, hence the final remaining composition pieces: (a) broader DOM panels beyond one textbox (capability map F04); (b) an explicit template-level assertion that focus and native editing/IME text survive a retained update and session replacement (F01/F04; none of the nine asserts toBeFocused or re-reads the note value across an update, the producer's own cases cover focus in Rendering); and a fresh installed receiver. (a) and (b) change shipped template source, so they belong with the next Workspace.Template release together with a durable reference localSaved journey. Durable product save belongs to FourD under #4819. AT stays with #4817.
title: All 19 Rendering 0.32.3 archives match custody at payload level; the DOM example composition has an executing case per element, with named gaps
